# Heading

and its visual size chosen independently. Props follow Atlassian's Heading (https://atlassian.design/components/heading).

**Import:** `import { Heading } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Heading/Heading.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/text-and-data-display/Heading/Heading.stories.jsx` — Sizes, AsOverride, Context, Inverse, Interactive

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `size` | enum | `'medium'` | The type-scale step, independent of `as`. |
| `as` | elementType | — | Override the rendered tag; otherwise the nearest `HeadingContextProvider`'s level, or the size's own default. |
| `color` | enum | `'default'` | `default` reads on a light surface; `inverse` on a bold/dark one. |
| `id` | string | — | — |
| `className` | string | — | — |
| `children` | node | — | — |

## Variants

**`size`** — `xxlarge` · `xlarge` · `large` · `medium` · `small` · `xsmall` · `xxsmall`

**`color`** — `default` · `inverse`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
